component: Folder-menu preference observers and cache lifetime

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The initialized folder menu observes mail.folder_widget preferences through its listener object. A change calls teardown, removes generated content and the observer, then clears initialization state. A later initialization builds from the new preferences; observe does not immediately repopulate rows. The added General-pane test asserts preference updates, not the regenerated submenu, so it does not directly test this cache lifecycle. This is a scoped static contract, not a runtime menu result.
title: Recent-destination preferences invalidate generated menus before the next build
